name: Cavalier Swan Knight
body:
Dedicated to protecting the defenseless, such as the aged, the infirm, or the very young, swan knights temper their strength of arms with compassion. Most swan knights are female, but that is more a tendency than a requirement.

Alignment: Any good.

Order: A swan knight must take the Order of the Swan.

Lay on Hands (Su)

At 1st level, the swan knight gains the ability to lay on hands as a paladin (even though a paladin normally gains this ability only at 2nd level).

This ability replaces tactician and greater tactician.

Channel Positive Energy (Su)

At 3rd level, the swan knight gains the ability to channel positive energy as a paladin.

This ability replaces cavalier’s charge and mighty charge.
